## Modules

- [Threadline.Capture.Migration](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Capture.Migration.md): SQL DDL for the Threadline audit schema.
- [Threadline.Capture.RedactionPolicy](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Capture.RedactionPolicy.md): Validates trigger redaction options at codegen time (Mix / `TriggerSQL`).
- [Threadline.Capture.TriggerCaptureConfig](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Capture.TriggerCaptureConfig.md): Shared loader for `config :threadline, :trigger_capture`.
- [Threadline.Capture.TriggerSQL](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Capture.TriggerSQL.md): Generates PL/pgSQL trigger DDL for Threadline audit capture.
- [Threadline.Export.CleanupTask](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Export.CleanupTask.md): A GenServer that periodically cleans up expired export jobs and abandons
jobs that have been stuck in the "running" state for too long.

- [Threadline.Export.Orchestrator](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Export.Orchestrator.md): Executes asynchronous export jobs safely by streaming directly to disk.

- [Threadline.ExportQueue](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.ExportQueue.md): Behaviour for enqueueing asynchronous export jobs.
- [Threadline.ExportQueue.Oban](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.ExportQueue.Oban.md): Oban-based implementation of `Threadline.ExportQueue`.
- [Threadline.ExportQueue.TaskAdapter](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.ExportQueue.TaskAdapter.md): A simple implementation of `Threadline.ExportQueue` using `Task.Supervisor`.
- [Threadline.Governance.EvidenceRecord](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Governance.EvidenceRecord.md): Ecto schema for the `threadline_evidence_records` table.
- [Threadline.Governance.ExportJob](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Governance.ExportJob.md): Ecto schema for the `threadline_export_jobs` table.
- [Threadline.Governance.Migration](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Governance.Migration.md): SQL DDL for the Threadline governance schema .
- [Threadline.Governance.RetentionRun](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Governance.RetentionRun.md): Ecto schema for the `threadline_retention_runs` table.
- [Threadline.Governance.SavedView](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Governance.SavedView.md): Ecto schema for the `threadline_saved_views` table.
- [Threadline.Health.Policy](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Health.Policy.md): Validates `:expected_uncovered_tables` and `:audit_anyway` configuration
for `Threadline.Health.trigger_coverage/1`'s third bucket.
- [Threadline.Investigation.IncidentBundle](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Investigation.IncidentBundle.md): One transaction-focused incident bundle with linked context and packaged diffs.

- [Threadline.Investigation.IncidentChange](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Investigation.IncidentChange.md): One bundled incident change with raw linked structs and a packaged diff.

- [Threadline.Investigation.LinkedChange](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Investigation.LinkedChange.md): One investigation change row with linked transaction and optional action context.

- [Threadline.Investigation.LinkedTransaction](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Investigation.LinkedTransaction.md): One transaction-oriented investigation slice with optional action metadata.

- [Threadline.OperatorSurface](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.md): Namespace for the Threadline operator surface — the opt-in mountable
LiveView surface that turns Threadline's investigation contracts into
one-click answers for documented support questions.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Components.SurfaceHeader](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Components.SurfaceHeader.md): Surface-wide header showing a coverage-drift badge that links to
`/audit/coverage`.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Controllers.ExportController](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Controllers.ExportController.md): HTTP-side parity controller for the operator-surface "Download CSV / JSON
/ NDJSON" affordances. Three actions (`csv/2`, `json/2`, `ndjson/2`); each
dispatches through one private `dispatch/3` so the format-vs-transport
branching is in one place.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Coverage.OnMount](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Coverage.OnMount.md): `live_session` `on_mount/4` callback that drives polled trigger-coverage
for every LV in the `:threadline` session.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Coverage.Snapshot](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Coverage.Snapshot.md): Snapshot of `Threadline.Health.trigger_coverage/1` results for the operator
surface coverage dashboard and surface-header pill.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.ExportAuthPlug](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.ExportAuthPlug.md): Conn-shaped authorize plug for the Threadline operator-surface export
endpoints. Conn-shaped twin of `Threadline.OperatorSurface.Auth.on_mount/4`.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Exports.Filename](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Exports.Filename.md): Canonical filename for operator-surface exports.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Exports.FilterParams](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Exports.FilterParams.md): Parses a string-keyed URL params map into a keyword list ready for
`Threadline.Query.validate_timeline_filters!/1`.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Live.ActorLive](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Live.ActorLive.md)
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Live.TransactionLive](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Live.TransactionLive.md)
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Scope](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Scope.md): Host-owned query scoping helpers for operator-surface flows.

- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Script](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Script.md): Embeds a tiny, dependency-free copy-to-clipboard helper for the operator
surface. Rendered once per page alongside `Threadline.OperatorSurface.Style.css/1`.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.SessionPlug](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.SessionPlug.md): A Plug that executes a configured `actor_fn` on the connection and stores the
serialized `ActorRef` in the session under the `"threadline_actor_ref"` key.
- [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Style](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Style.md): Provides isolated CSS for the Threadline Operator Surface.

- [Threadline.Policy.RedactionPresenter](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Policy.RedactionPresenter.md): Shared redaction drift presenter for Mix and LiveView parity.
- [Threadline.Query.ActorHistoryPage](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Query.ActorHistoryPage.md): One keyset page from the actor history query layer.

- [Threadline.Query.TimelinePage](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Query.TimelinePage.md): One keyset page from the timeline query layer.

- [Threadline.Retention.Pruner](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Retention.Pruner.md): A GenServer that schedules and executes background retention pruning.
- [Threadline.Semantics.Migration](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Semantics.Migration.md): DDL helpers for the Threadline semantics schema .
- [Threadline.Storage](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Storage.md): Behaviour for storing and retrieving export files and other persistent artifacts.
- [Threadline.Storage.Local](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Storage.Local.md): Local filesystem implementation of `Threadline.Storage`.
- [Threadline.Storage.S3](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Storage.S3.md): S3 implementation of `Threadline.Storage`.
- [Threadline.Verify.CoveragePolicy](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Verify.CoveragePolicy.md): Pure policy for comparing `Threadline.Health.trigger_coverage/1` output with
host-configured expected audited table names.

- Core API
  - [Threadline](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.md): Audit platform for Elixir teams using Phoenix, Ecto, and PostgreSQL.
  - [Threadline.Audit](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Audit.md): Audited write-path helper — one call for transaction-local actor GUC, domain
writes, optional semantic action linkage, and `audit_transaction_id` on success.
  - [Threadline.ChangeDiff](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.ChangeDiff.md): Pure projection of a single captured row change into deterministic, JSON-friendly maps.
  - [Threadline.Export](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Export.md): CSV and JSON export for audited row changes.
  - [Threadline.Investigation](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Investigation.md): Higher-level investigation helpers layered on top of Threadline query primitives.
  - [Threadline.Query](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Query.md): Ecto query implementations for the Threadline public API.
  - [Threadline.Retention](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Retention.md): Batched retention purge for `audit_changes` and empty `audit_transactions`.
  - [Threadline.Retention.Policy](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Retention.Policy.md): Validates **`config :threadline, :retention`** before purge runs.
  - [Threadline.Semantics.ActorRef](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Semantics.ActorRef.md): Value object representing the actor who performed an audited operation.
  - [Threadline.Semantics.AuditContext](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Semantics.AuditContext.md): Execution context for an audited request or job.

- Evidence
  - [Threadline.Evidence](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Evidence.md): Public create/read boundary for Threadline-owned evidence records.
  - [Threadline.Evidence.Proof](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Evidence.Proof.md): Reusable proof projection for Threadline evidence viewer surfaces.

  - [Threadline.Evidence.Subject](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Evidence.Subject.md): Closed subject inventory for Threadline-owned evidence records.

- Integration
  - [Threadline.Continuity](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Continuity.md): Brownfield cutover helpers for honest **T₀** semantics with Threadline capture.
  - [Threadline.Health](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Health.md): Health checks for Threadline infrastructure.
  - [Threadline.Job](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Job.md): Helpers for propagating audit context through background job `args` maps.
  - [Threadline.Plug](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Plug.md): Plug that extracts `AuditContext` from a `Plug.Conn` and stores it in
`conn.assigns[:audit_context]`.
  - [Threadline.Telemetry](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Telemetry.md): Telemetry integration helpers for Threadline.

- Integrations
  - [Threadline.Integrations.Sigra](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Integrations.Sigra.md): Soft-dependency adapter for deriving Threadline audit context from Sigra state.

- Operator Surface (Optional In-Tree)
  - [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Auth](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Auth.md): Authentication contract for the Threadline operator surface.

  - [Threadline.OperatorSurface.Router](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.OperatorSurface.Router.md): Provides the `threadline_operator_surface/2` macro to mount the
Threadline LiveView interface within a Phoenix router.

- Schemas
  - [Threadline.Capture.AuditChange](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Capture.AuditChange.md): Ecto schema for the `audit_changes` table.
  - [Threadline.Capture.AuditTransaction](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Capture.AuditTransaction.md): Ecto schema for the `audit_transactions` table.
  - [Threadline.Semantics.AuditAction](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Threadline.Semantics.AuditAction.md): Ecto schema for the `audit_actions` table.

## Mix Tasks

- Mix Tasks
  - [mix threadline.continuity](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.Continuity.md): Brownfield capture cutover helper — honest T0 semantics (see `guides/brownfield-continuity.md`).
  - [mix threadline.evidence.show](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.Evidence.Show.md): Shows Threadline-owned evidence proof output through one canonical viewer task.
  - [mix threadline.export](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.Export.md): Loads application config, starts the configured Ecto repo, and writes an export file
using `Threadline.Export` — **no** ad-hoc `Ecto.Query` in this task (parity with
`mix threadline.retention.purge`).
  - [mix threadline.gen.triggers](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.Gen.Triggers.md): Generates an Ecto migration that installs Threadline audit triggers on the
specified tables.
  - [mix threadline.health.coverage](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.Health.Coverage.md): Shows trigger coverage as reported by `Threadline.Health.trigger_coverage/1`,
with a three-section table (default) or JSON output (`--json`).
  - [mix threadline.incident](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.Incident.md): Loads application config, starts the configured Ecto repo, and fetches
the incident bundle for a given transaction ID.
  - [mix threadline.install](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.Install.md): Generates an Ecto migration file for the Threadline audit schema.
  - [mix threadline.policy.show](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.Policy.Show.md): Shows configured versus deployed redaction policy drift for Threadline capture
triggers, using the shared `Threadline.Policy.RedactionPresenter`.
  - [mix threadline.retention.purge](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.Retention.Purge.md): Delegates to `Threadline.Retention.purge/1` after loading application config and
starting the configured Ecto repo (same resolution pattern as `mix threadline.verify_coverage`).
  - [mix threadline.verify_coverage](https://threadline.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Threadline.VerifyCoverage.md): Verifies that tables listed in application config have Threadline audit
triggers installed, using the same catalog queries as `Threadline.Health.trigger_coverage/1`.
